vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Company makes the road shorter.

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get from Kochi, Kerala, India. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
You catch fragments by the fire — Oliver telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.

A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm claps your shoulder. "You're doing better than you think." (+15 energy — morale is real.)
You've started noticing: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm and A person, maybe 50s, with a shaved head never speak. It's not new. (Something old lives in Haven.)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Hmm. That doesn't add up. Let me think it through out loud."
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm quietly adds to the pantry without being asked. "For later. All of us." (+150 kcal)
👂 Overheard — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Interesting. But what's the underlying pattern?"
✅ You saw the creek. A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇯🇵 Japanese. You share no language at all.
